evidence: 真实启动日志: PostgreSQL 18.6 ready on Unix socket .s.PGSQL.16432 (127.0.0.1:8080 HTTP)
initdb binary 存在: .runtime/pg-brew/postgresql@18/18.6_1/bin/initdb (214KB, Homebrew PG 18.6)

data dir: ~/Library/Application Support/MCP Studio/ — 完整 PG 集群 (PG_VERSION=18, base/, global/, pg_wal/)
ensureInitdb 逻辑: dirExists && PG_VERSION → 跳过 initdb; dirExists && 无 PG_VERSION && 有非点文件 → 拒绝; 空/不存在 → initdb 重建
